name: cronwatch-monorepo
description: CronWatch: cron and scheduled-job monitoring that lives inside your app. SDK, MCP server and the cronwatch.dev site.

scripts.test: npm run check:dashes && npm test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:contact && npm run test:scripts
scripts.build: npm run check:dashes && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:dashes && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:conformance
scripts.conformance: npm run build --workspace packages/sdk && TZ=UTC node --import tsx scripts/conformance.mjs
scripts.check:conformance: npm run build --workspace packages/sdk && TZ=UTC node --import tsx scripts/conformance.mjs --check && TZ=UTC node packages/ruby/test/web/golden.mjs --check && node scripts/make-dashboard-icons.mjs --check
